title: New Orleans piano players: Udell Wilson
summary: Asked about unrecorded New Orleans barrelhouse pianists, he names Steve Lewis and Udell Wilson, a long-fingered Kansas City player who worked the downtown joints in the 1920s.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
